headline: Bring AdGuard Home into your automations
intro: Connect your AdGuard Home instance to Home Assistant to monitor DNS activity and manage protection settings. Track query and filtering statistics, then use switches to control features such as DNS filtering, Safe browsing, parental control, Safe search, and query logging.
highlights: Monitor DNS queries, blocked requests, active filter rules, and average processing speed
Control AdGuard Home protection, filtering, Safe browsing, parental control, Safe search, and query logging
Use the available entities in automations, such as enabling parental control during school hours
